descriptions.counterfactual: A motor turns a copper disk beneath a freely rotating bar magnet mounted on a separate overhead pivot. An air gap separates the disk and magnet. Without another drive, the magnet instead rotates continuously opposite to the disk.
descriptions.true: A motor turns a copper disk beneath a freely rotating bar magnet mounted on a separate overhead pivot. An air gap separates the disk and magnet. The magnet gradually rotates in the same direction as the disk through electromagnetic induction.

generation.motion_authority: Quasistatic eddy-current drag torque k*(disk_speed-magnet_speed) and ordinary positive viscous pivot resistance d*magnet_speed. d=3k keeps both signs bounded. Only k changes sign in CF. Ambient magnetic alignment is neglected; this is a phenomenological induction model, not a field solver or native Blender dynamics.
